## About
Perez Logistics is a family owned business based in Houston, Texas. Our commitment is simple: get your shipment to its destination as safely and quickly as possible, and give you a fair value while we do it.
Customers rate us 4.9 from 22 reviews on Google. One customer told people to call Erika and Jefferson for their logistics needs, and another called us hardworking people with superb service.

## Services
- Container service from Houston Port: One customer used our service for containers from Houston Port to Dallas and said the price was fair.
- Shipping Quotes: Tell us about your shipment and ask for a quote.
